dialect.detail: ACUCOBOL-GT / Micro Focus ACUCOBOL dialect, generated by TOTEM framework (Italian ERP/order management system). Uses ACUCOBOL-specific extensions: HANDLE OF WINDOW, HANDLE OF FONT, HANDLE OF STATUS-BAR, COMP-4, UNSIGNED-INT, SMALL-FONT, DEFAULT-FONT, CRT STATUS, 78-level constants, XFD directives.

purpose.domain_detail: Italian wholesale/distribution ERP - EDI order import and management (gestione importazioni ordini EDI). Handles customers, destinations, agents, articles, promotions, price lists, warehouses, payment terms, and order selection/processing.
purpose.summary: This is a large ACUCOBOL batch/interactive program generated by the TOTEM framework for an Italian ERP system (GESLUX EDI). It manages the selection and processing of EDI-imported purchase orders, including customer validation, article/price/promotion checks, warehouse stock, and order status management. The program presents a GUI-based order selection grid and handles order editing, saving, printing, and validation workflows.
